body.name: Closed-perspective procedure program
body.construction: \(\mathsf P=\min \overline R\) over \(d_n\ge0\) and \(t_{n\omega}\) subject to \(\sum_nd_n=1\), \(-Ld_n\le t_{n\omega}\le Ld_n\), and \(\sum_{n,\omega}H_{\kappa n\omega}(t_{n\omega}-d_n\theta_\kappa)^2/d_n\le \overline R\) for every \(\kappa\in\mathcal K\), using the closed quadratic perspective at \(d_n=0\).
